sn4.4:1.1: Evam me sutam ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati Isipatane migadāye || || Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi || || Bhikkhavo ti || || Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn4.4:2.1: Mayhaṃ kho bhikkhave yoniso manasikārā yoniso sammappadhānā anuttarā vimutti anuppattā anuttarā vimutti sacchikatā || Tumhe pi bhikkhave yoniso manasikārā yoniso sammappadhānā anuttaraṃ vimuttim anupāpuṇātha anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ sacchikarothā ti || || Atha kho Māro pāpimā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.4:3.1: Baddho-si māra-pāsena || ye dibbā ye ca mānusā || māra-bandhana-baddhosi || na me samaṇa mokkhasīti || ||
sn4.4:4.1: Mutto-ham māra-pāsena || ye dibbā ye ca mānusā |||| mārabandhana-mutto mhi || nihato tvam asi antakāti || ||
sn4.4:5.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā || la || tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || ||
